name: add-note
description: Adds a note to a HubSpot contact, company or deal (the record id from hubspot__find-contact, hubspot__find-deal or hubspot__get-record), logged on its timeline at the given time or now, with an optional owner (an id from hubspot__list-owners).

objectType.description: The type of HubSpot record to associate with the note.

recordId.description: The record's id: a contact's from hubspot__find-contact, a deal's from hubspot__find-deal, a company's from the associations hubspot__get-record answers.

timestamp.description: The note timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to the current time.

ownerId.description: Optional HubSpot owner ID, from hubspot__list-owners.
